title: New Terms, New Toxicity: Consensus-based Chinese Neologism Toxicity Detection via Search-Augmented LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.12361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neologisms, emerging terms in meaning or form, can serve as new vehicles for toxic expression, like "country girl" as a stigmatizing label targeting feminism. Such toxic neologisms appear benign but have evolved into toxic usage in public consensus, posing challenges to moderation systems and remaining underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how to detect implicit toxicity expressed via neologisms. We first propose a taxonomy that captures the origins and consensus-verification criteria of toxic neologisms, followed by the construction of a lexicon spanning widely observed risk categories. To capture toxicity grounded in public consensus, we introduce SeTox, a search-augmented framework that enables static large language models (LLMs) to incorporate real-time web context for neologism toxicity detection. translated_title: 新词、新毒性：基于共识的中文新词毒性检测通过搜索增强的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：新词，即在意义或形式上新兴的术语，可以作为有毒表达的新载体，例如“村姑”作为针对女权主义的污名化标签。这类有毒新词表面上看似无害，但在公众共识中已演变为有毒用法，对审核系统构成挑战，且尚未得到充分研究。本文探讨了如何检测通过新词表达的隐性毒性。我们首先提出一个分类体系，捕捉有毒新词的起源和共识验证标准，随后构建了一个涵盖广泛观察风险类别的词汇表。为了捕捉基于公众共识的毒性，我们引入了SeTox，一个搜索增强框架，使静态大语言模型（LLMs）能够整合实时网络上下文进行新词毒性检测。实验表明，SeTox即使使用3B规模的模型，也能超越近期的大规模模型，展示了其可扩展性。
tldr: 本文提出SeTox，一个通过搜索增强大语言模型结合实时网络上下文来检测中文新词隐性毒性的框架，并构建了基于共识验证的有毒新词分类和词汇表，实验证明其在小规模模型下也能超越大规模模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SeTox, a search-augmented framework that enables LLMs to detect implicit toxicity in Chinese neologisms by incorporating real-time web context, along with a taxonomy and lexicon based on consensus verification, demonstrating superior performance even with 3B-scale models.
